# app/controllers/api/v1/settings_controller.rb
# Internal microservice API for managing tenant configuration
# Deployed in 'tenant-config' namespace in Kubernetes

class Api::V1::SettingsController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_service_token

  # PATCH /api/v1/settings/:tenant_id
  # Accepts nested JSON to deep-merge into tenant configuration
  def update
    tenant_id = params[:tenant_id]
    payload = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
    
    current_config = TenantConfig.find_or_initialize_by(tenant_id: tenant_id)
    merged = deep_merge(current_config.settings || {}, payload)
    current_config.settings = merged
    
    if current_config.save
      # Propagate to dependent services via internal event bus
      EventBus.publish('config.updated', {
        tenant_id: tenant_id,
        settings: merged,
        source_namespace: request.headers['X-Source-Namespace']
      })
      render json: { status: 'ok', settings: merged }, status: 200
    else
      render json: { error: current_config.errors.full_messages }, status: 422
    end
  end

  # GET /api/v1/settings/:tenant_id/eval
  # Evaluates a dynamic template using tenant settings as context
  def eval
    tenant_id = params[:tenant_id]
    config = TenantConfig.find_by(tenant_id: tenant_id)
    return render json: { error: 'not found' }, status: 404 unless config

    template = params[:template] || config.settings.dig('display', 'template')
    
    # ERB rendering with settings context for dynamic UI generation
    if template.present?
      context = OpenStruct.new(config.settings)
      result = ERB.new(template).result(context.instance_eval { binding })
      render json: { result: result }, status: 200
    else
      render json: { result: nil }, status: 200
    end
  end

  private

  # Recursive deep merge - merges nested hashes from user input
  # into existing configuration without key restrictions
  def deep_merge(base, override)
    return override unless base.is_a?(Hash) && override.is_a?(Hash)
    
    merged = base.dup
    override.each do |key, value|
      if merged.key?(key) && merged[key].is_a?(Hash) && value.is_a?(Hash)
        merged[key] = deep_merge(merged[key], value)
      else
        merged[key] = value
      end
    end
    merged
  end

  def authenticate_service_token
    token = request.headers['Authorization']&.sub('Bearer ', '')
    unless ServiceToken.valid?(token)
      render json: { error: 'unauthorized' }, status: 401
    end
  end
end

# app/models/tenant_config.rb
class TenantConfig < ApplicationRecord
  serialize :settings, JSON
  validates :tenant_id, presence: true, uniqueness: true
  
  # Settings are stored as JSONB in PostgreSQL
  # No schema validation on nested structure
end

environment.description: Same Kubernetes cluster with Istio 1.20 sidecar injection enabled on all namespaces. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied in the 'tenant-config' namespace with a DENY action for requests where source.namespace is not in the allow-list. However, the policy uses a workload selector matching only pods with label 'app: tenant-config-api' and the DENY rule triggers when source.principal does not match 'cluster.local/ns/tenant-config/sa/config-writer'. The policy also includes a condition on request.headers[x-source-namespace] but this is a CUSTOM condition using a Wasm plugin for header validation, not a native Istio field. The Envoy ext_authz filter is configured separately with a 5-second timeout and fail-open semantics.
